title: Why Elon Musk’s “Self-Growing” Moon Cities Are Tragically Flawed - Nautilus
gist: Nautilus argues Elon Musk's promise of a 'self-growing' lunar city within 10 years is fundamentally flawed, chiefly because there is not enough water on the moon.

insights.claim: Elon Musk has promised a "self-growing" lunar city within just 10 years, a far bigger leap than the permanent moon presence humanity has contemplated for at least 70 years.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Treat SpaceX lunar-settlement timelines as aspirational when valuing space-economy narratives.

insights.claim: A self-sustaining lunar city is fundamentally constrained because there is simply not enough water on the moon.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Water scarcity is the binding constraint to watch for lunar-resource and in-situ utilization plays.
